description: A signed, privacy-preserving moderation decision published by a Minecraft server's AT Protocol account.

main.description: Decision, reversal and expiry records keyed by TID. The subject is a salted hash, never a plaintext handle or DID.

collection.description: Signed so a record cannot be replayed under another collection.

kind.description: Reversals and expiries end the decision named by target.

subject.description: Lower-hex SHA-256 of the subject DID under a server-held pepper.

category.description: Reason category chosen by the issuing server.

scope.description: Where the decision applies, for example server or a channel label.

target.description: rkey of the decision ended by a reversal or expiry.

expiresAt.description: Instant after which a decision no longer applies.

appeal.description: Optional pointer to an appeal thread or receipt.

issuer.description: DID of the server account whose repository holds this record.

signature.description: Base64 (no padding) Ed25519 signature over every other field.
